description: Standalone RDS DB instance deletion protection is disabled
rationale: A standalone RDS DB instance reports DeletionProtection=false. Aurora and Multi-AZ DB cluster members are excluded and must instead be assessed using DBCluster DeletionProtection. Missing or malformed cluster membership stays UNKNOWN, not compliant.
remediation: For standalone DB instances, review the operational need and enable DeletionProtection where appropriate. For Aurora and Multi-AZ DB clusters, review cluster-level deletion protection separately.
